access_boundary: This record represents the tencent/Hy-MT2-30B-A3B weight release announced on 2026-05-21 at Hugging Face commit d3ead4dba61c09aac60a261a96ad1df3e705febb (last modified 2026-07-21). The other Hy-MT2 sizes, the FP8, GGUF, and low-bit quantized repackagings, the earlier HY-MT1.5 and Hunyuan-MT releases, and any hosted translation service remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated checkpoint with a dedicated Apache-2.0 LICENSE.txt, full LoRA and full fine-tuning scripts, and vLLM and SGLang recipes in the repository
Model card documents recommended sampling settings and a per-language prompt format for translation
tradeoffs: Model card names no hosted endpoint for this exact release, so served access must be arranged independently
Loading needs transformers 5.6 or newer with trust_remote_code, and version identity rests on a moving main branch
